SessionCard.description: The card a session worked on, as far as sprint-metrics needs to read it.

created.description: The day the card was filed, as on every event.
created.title: Created

type.description: The card's type on the board. None for a role's Task, which has none.
type.title: Type

SessionCard.title: SessionCard

description:
What happened in one session: its card, role, start, finish, model time and tokens.

The same identity as every event the intake takes, with the role added: a re-sent
session is the same `card_id` (or none), `type`, `timestamp` and `role`. Two members
of a panel can start on one card in the same moment.

cached_tokens.description: Of its prompt tokens, those the server's prefix cache held.
cached_tokens.title: Cached Tokens

card_id.description: The card, as `repo#number`. A review's card is the one its pull request closes, when it closes exactly one. None when there's no card to name: a pull request that closes none (`pull` says which), or a session on no card, such as a retro.
card_id.title: Card Id

epic.description: The epic the card's split from, as `repo#number`, so a story's sessions add up to its epic. None for a card with no parent, as a Bug has.
epic.title: Epic

finished.description: When it finished. None when the record has no finish: the tick stopped partway, so its minutes are unknown, never zero.
finished.title: Finished

model_seconds.description: Its model calls' time, in seconds. A call with no time recorded adds nothing. None, never zero, when no call of it has one.
model_seconds.title: Model Seconds

part.description: Planning or building, by the step of the crew its model calls were for. `refinement`: refine, design, panel, goal look, order, revisit. `delivery`: deliver, session, qa, review, deploy review, resolution. None: the retro, which is neither, or a session whose calls name no step, or that has none recorded.
part.title: Part

prompt_tokens.description: Tokens sent; None as for the time.
prompt_tokens.title: Prompt Tokens

pull.description: The pull request a review worked on, as `repo#number`. None for other work.
pull.title: Pull

reasoning_tokens.description: Of those, the ones spent reasoning.
reasoning_tokens.title: Reasoning Tokens

role.description: The role that worked. A later MINOR may add roles.
role.title: Role

sprint.description: The sprint whose days it started in.
sprint.title: Sprint

type.description: The new event type mqucifer/crew#1001 sends.
type.title: Type

title: SessionEvent
